newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Chidambaram says decision on MAT soon.
newsitem.headline: India's Chidambaram says decision on MAT soon.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram was quoted on Thursday as saying he would take a decision on the controversial Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT) on corporations soon.
The Press Trust of India (PTI) quoted Chidambaram as saying he was aware of industry's opposition to the tax he imposed in last year's budget.
The news agency said Chidambaram, who was speaking on the margins of the Confederation of Indian Industry's annual meeting in Calcutta, gave no details of his plan.

A government statement on Wednesday said senior economists who met Chidambaram for a discussion ahead of the 1997/98 (April-March) budget, expected to be unveiled next month, had supported the continuation of MAT.
But Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda told businessmen recently he had an open mind on the issue.
